QuestInfo.name: Mai's First Training
QuestInfo.0: Lucas introduces you to someone who can train you. #bEast of Amherst#k, you can find #bMai#k. Better head over.
QuestInfo.1: Mai instructs you to hunt #r5 Stumps#k and collect #b3 Tree Branches#k. \n\nStump #r#a10411##k #i4000003# #t4000003# #b#c4000003# #k/3
QuestInfo.2: You managed to hunt 5 Stumps, gather all the branches, and report it all to Mai.

0.0: Hey! Lucas sent you, right? I'm Mai. I used to fight in Victoria Island, but I hang around here these days, recharging and training. Don't worry, I can make time to help you.
0.1: Shall we start? I'll start your training off easy. Ready?

yes.0: Here. Take this #bRazor#k. It's a type of dagger. It should be slightly more powerful than what you currently have. To hunt well, you need good weapons, so take this one as a gift. Don't forget to #bequip#k it!
yes.1: Now, go hunt #r5 Stumps#k and bring back #b3 Tree Branches#k. Stumps have a lot of HP, but they're so slow that you shouldn't have too much trouble. Enter the portal to my right to find them. Good luck!

no.0: It's dangerous to start training if you aren't mentally prepared. Let me know when you're ready.

item.0: You haven't defeated #r5 Stumps#k and brought back #b3 Tree Branches#k yet. Some Stumps drop branches. Others don't. Just be patient and keep hunting.
